context: A police officer briefs on a corporate-IP case
purpose: Teach: 毀損/百科/後編/運搬/ネック/選別/結びつける/招か

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社の知的財産、毀損リスク、警察も把握しています。
lines.en: Your company's intellectual property and the risks to it — we're tracking this closely.
lines.style: Professional, steady authority without coldness. Measured pace. Slight weight on 'tracking' — the reassurance that this is being taken seriously.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。百科辞典級の社内資料、流出防止に努めます。
lines.en: Yes. We understand — those internal documents are sensitive. We're strengthening our leak-prevention protocols.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly formal. Nodding in the voice. Clear enunciation on 'preventing' — showing he's committed. Not defensive, but taking it as his responsibility.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: シリーズの後編、ロゴ盗用、ご注意を。
lines.en: The second phase of the series especially — watch for logo counterfeiting. That's a common attack vector.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, procedural tone. Light emphasis on 'watch' and 'logo' — flagging key points. Calm but attentive, like reading from experience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 運搬中の荷物、追跡システム、強化済みです。
lines.en: We've already upgraded the tracking systems on goods in transit. It's in place now.
lines.style: Steady, confident. Measured delivery — not rushing to reassure, just stating fact. Slight upward lift at the end, inviting acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 発覚遅延がネック、初動の選別、迅速に。
lines.en: Detection lag is your real vulnerability right now. We need faster initial response — spotting problems before they spread.
lines.style: Gentle but direct. Leans forward slightly in tone. Specific weight on 'faster' — this matters. Not scolding, but clear about the priority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察と業界、引き続き結びつける場、設けます。
lines.en: We'll set up regular liaison meetings between police and your industry partners. Keep those channels open.
lines.style: Warm but formal. Measured, collaborative tone — building a bridge. Slight lift on 'open,' inviting partnership not surveillance.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 招かれて、来週講演します。
lines.en: I've been asked to give a talk next week on exactly this — IP protection frameworks.
lines.style: Understated. Small note of satisfaction but not self-promotion — just matter-of-fact. Slight pause before 'next week,' like he's checking his own schedule. Warm closer.
